posts.title: The Warrior at the Gate
posts.description: He takes his brother’s place, then waits at a city gate. The weapon he must keep away from is still inside. — Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara Kāṇḍa, chapters 60–70 (Shastri received numbering). Ages 8+, about 6 minutes read aloud.

posts.title: The Night Shatrughna Heard the Rāmāyaṇa
posts.description: Twelve years after hearing of the twins’ birth, he returns to the same hermitage. This time, a song brings tears. — Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Uttara Kāṇḍa, chapters 65–66, 70–71 (Shastri received numbering). Ages 7+, about 6 minutes read aloud.

posts.title: The Enemy Who Was Still a Brother
posts.description: Vibhīṣaṇa grieves for the brother he opposed. Rāma tells him that the funeral rites must still be performed. — Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha Kāṇḍa, received-text sargas 109 and 111. Ages 9+, about 6 minutes read aloud.
